observations: Fourth reproduction of the LaunchServices lock with the same waiter/owner roles.
The uninterruptible thread moved from lsd to backboardd between boots while the seeding and lock waits stayed, which fits a shared lower layer rather than one process's logic.
The kernel wait channel is a heap object, so naming the subsystem needs zone or kernel-stack evidence, not symbols.
limitations: A heap wait event has no symbol; zone/object introspection is required to name it.
Only threads whose kstate carries the uninterruptible bit printed w, so interruptible waiters stay invisible.
Five of five lsd threads were sampled this boot, but lsd's thread population still changes between boots.
